page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-32-lssd is a compute-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with 32 vCPUs (16 physical cores) operating at 2.3 GHz. It features an x86_64 architecture with a 504 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 120 GB of RAM, providing 3.75 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 1745 GB of NVMe SSD capacity spread across five local SSDs. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, highlighted by a Geekbench single-core score of 2304.0 and single-threaded gzip compression of 36.97 GB/sec. Multi-threaded capabilities are strong, with a Passmark CPU score of 52401.15 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18164.0. The processor's advanced vector and matrix extensions (AVX-512 and AMX) support efficient mathematical operations, reflected in strong text processing and image processing benchmarks. Memory bandwidth reaches 2707.87 GB/sec for cached small blocks, though uncached large-block write bandwidth drops to 29.86 GB/sec.

This server is highly suited for workloads requiring high-speed local storage and strong compute capabilities, such as high-throughput Redis databases, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks. Its qualitative cost efficiency is driven by the high density of dedicated compute resources and fast local NVMe storage, making it an effective choice for data-intensive processing pipelines and web applications that benefit from low-latency local disk access without the overhead of external network storage.
